quoteId.description: Canonical UUID or registered quote number alias

requestKey.description: Optional existing finance request key; used only by canonical FINANCE_ACK.

Evidence.description: Manual external facts, not simulated adapter success. ALLOCATION requires expiresAt; its externalReference identifies the allocation lot. SHIPMENT/RELEASE require that lot identifier as allocationReference; DELIVERY requires shipmentReference. Expired observations are retained as CONFLICT; a new valid allocation must expire in the future. Canonical FINANCE_ACK implies ACKNOWLEDGED and uses finance authority.

requestKey.description: Optional; when supplied must equal the existing stable finance request key.

FinanceAcknowledgment.description: Manual authoritative downstream evidence. All outcomes require positive quantity and real external reference/time. Only ACKNOWLEDGED increments cumulative acknowledged quantity; REJECTED/UNKNOWN retain immutable observations and open exceptions.

expectedVersion.description: Current exception version, not order version.
Current exception version, not order version.

Resolution.description: RECONCILE closes only findings disproven by durable state; RETRY delegates executor fences. WAIVE is permitted only for informational REVIEW_NOTE, never unknown effects or failed obligations.

status.description: SUCCEEDED is a durable local command receipt, not external completion. ABANDONED reserves an absent client command identity and rejects late delivery. NOT_FOUND/UNKNOWN/PENDING never authorize a new key. UNKNOWN/PENDING are reserved conservative client states; current durable lookups return SUCCEEDED, NOT_FOUND or ABANDONED.

payload.description: Frozen request JSON: source line billing terms, tax evidence, prerequisite milestones and integer grossCents/discountCents/taxCents/totalCents. Request creation does not mean invoice or acknowledgment.

Error.description: Application errors use ApiResponse. errorCode/traceId are optional; supported canonical handlers emit OMS_<HTTP status>. Authentication middleware may return an empty or framework error response.

FulfillmentEvidence.description: Manual external facts, not simulated adapter success. ALLOCATION requires expiresAt; its externalReference identifies the allocation lot. SHIPMENT/RELEASE require that lot identifier as allocationReference; DELIVERY requires shipmentReference. Expired observations are retained as CONFLICT; a new valid allocation must expire in the future.

Adjudication.description: Append-only disavowal of unapplied CONFLICT evidence; authority time cannot predate the observation. Does not retract applied evidence or change quantities. Requires both recovery and evidence permissions.
